item.text: {"summary":"The shared NaN edge-case handler receives the parsed sign but calls MakeNan without applying it. Both float and double failures match this path, and the tests also require the NaN payload to match the positive result with its sign copied. The evidence is sufficient for a concrete repair.","hypotheses":["HandleEdgeCase ignores the negative flag for NaNs, so both float and double parsing return a NaN with the positive sign bit."],"queries":[],"reads":[],"ready":true}
